mapper.insert: insert into user( username, password, real_name, phone, email, avatar_bucket, avatar_object_key, role ) values( #{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{avatarBucket}, #{avatarObjectKey}, #{role,jdbcType=TINYINT} )
mapper.update: update user set username=#{username}, real_name=#{realName}, phone=#{phone}, email=#{email}, avatar_bucket=#{avatarBucket}, avatar_object_key=#{avatarObjectKey}, role=#{role}, update_time=#{updateTime} where id = #{id}
update user set password =#{newPassword} where id=#{id} and password =#{oldPassword}
mapper.select: select id, username, password, real_name as realName, phone, email, avatar_bucket as avatarBucket, avatar_object_key as avatarObjectKey, role, status, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from user order by id desc

select id, username, password, real_name as realName, phone, email, avatar_bucket as avatarBucket, avatar_object_key as avatarObjectKey, role, status, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from user where id = #{id}

select id, username, password, real_name as realName, phone, email, avatar_bucket as avatarBucket, avatar_object_key as avatarObjectKey, role, status, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from user where id=#{id} and password = #{oldPassword}

select id, username, password, real_name as realName, phone, email, avatar_bucket as avatarBucket, avatar_object_key as avatarObjectKey, role, status, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from user where username = #{username} and password = #{password}
SELECT id, username FROM user WHERE username = #{username}
